description: Source code implementing OpenCDM system and session management functions, including secure stop handling, version retrieval, and property parsing, with JSON-based configuration.

classes.name: PlayLevelsJSON
classes.description: JSON container class for parsing and storing media property levels from JSON string.

methods.name: opencdm_create_system
methods.description: Deprecated function to create an OpenCDM system object using key system string.

methods.name: opencdm_create_system_extended
methods.description: Creates an OpenCDM system object with extended parameters, returning error code.

methods.name: opencdm_system_get_version
methods.description: Retrieves version string of the given OpenCDM system.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_get_ldl_session_limit
methods.description: Gets LDL session limit for the specified system.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_is_secure_stop_enabled
methods.description: Checks if secure stop is enabled for the system.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_enable_secure_stop
methods.description: Enables or disables secure stop for the system.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_reset_secure_stop
methods.description: Resets secure stop states for the system.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_get_secure_stop_ids
methods.description: Retrieves secure stop IDs for the system.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_get_secure_stop
methods.description: Gets secure stop data for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_commit_secure_stop
methods.description: Commits secure stop data to the system.

methods.name: opencdm_system_get_drm_time
methods.description: Gets DRM system time.

methods.name: opencdm_session_get_session_id_ext
methods.description: Retrieves extended session ID.

methods.name: opencdm_destruct_session_ext
methods.description: Releases and destroys a session object.

methods.name: opencdm_session_set_drm_header
methods.description: Sets DRM header data for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_get_challenge_data
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: opencdm_session_cancel_challenge_data
methods.description: Cancels ongoing challenge data process.

methods.name: opencdm_session_store_license_data
methods.description: Stores license data in session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_select_key_id
methods.description: Selects a key ID for the session.

methods.name: opencdm_session_clean_decrypt_context
methods.description: Cleans decryption context for a session.

methods.name: opencdm_delete_key_store
methods.description: Deletes key store for the system.

methods.name: opencdm_delete_secure_store
methods.description: Deletes secure store for the system.

methods.name: opencdm_get_key_store_hash_ext
methods.description: Retrieves hash of key store.

methods.name: opencdm_get_secure_store_hash_ext
methods.description: Retrieves hash of secure store.

methods.name: opencdm_system_ext_get_properties
methods.description: Parses media property levels from JSON string and updates system properties.
